# PDF composition

- pdf-lib, 1.17.1. [Source](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib). [MIT licence](pdf-lib.LICENSE.md).
- @pdf-lib/fontkit, 1.1.1. [Source](https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit). [Licence](fontkit.LICENSE.txt).

Both libraries run locally in the browser. They embed the bundled DejaVu Sans Mono subset and the selected archival images into the PDF.
